entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was early in the morning. Lucita..."
entries.dialogueText: It was early in the morning. Lucita and I were about to depart for a royal visit to Terador Air Force Base when I got an urgent summons from Hugo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I walked through the council chambe..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked through the council chamber doors to find my uncle and my foreign affairs councilor waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Esquibel, Your Grace. To what..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Esquibel, Your Grace. To what do I owe this interruption?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please tell me there's good news.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please tell me there's good news."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope this is quick, gentlemen. D..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this is quick, gentlemen. Duchess Azaro and I are on a tight schedule."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The two men glanced at each other."
entries.dialogueText: The two men glanced at each other.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your Majesty... we have received t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... we have received the results from the joint investigation into the Palesian border incident."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Quite simply, our earlier hypothes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Quite simply, our earlier hypotheses that the attack was incited by Pales or staged by a third party were not borne out."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Instead, all evidence seemed to in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Instead, all evidence seemed to indicate an inside job, one masterminded by..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a deep breath. He couldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a deep breath. He couldn't bring himself to go on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By whom? Spit it out, man!""
entries.dialogueText: "By whom? Spit it out, man!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, Mr. Esquibel. If there's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Mr. Esquibel. If there's a traitor in our midst, I need to know who it is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hugo?""
entries.dialogueText: "Hugo?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The named culprit was Lucita Azaro..."
entries.dialogueText: "The named culprit was Lucita Azaro, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How certain are they?""
entries.dialogueText: "How certain are they?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What?! They'll pay for soiling the..."
entries.dialogueText: "What?! They'll pay for soiling the name of a capable councilor and esteemed noblewoman."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Azaros have been working again..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros have been working against me this whole time?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know Duchess Azaro well. She'd n..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know Duchess Azaro well. She'd never do a thing like that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento frowned.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'd like to believe the same. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd like to believe the same. But you have to consider the possibility that the Duchess entered into your confidence precisely so that you'd take her side in the case of such an incident."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento frowned.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We don't know the precise details...."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't know the precise details. The Duchess could have been acting in cooperation with her house, or alone."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That was my first thought as well...."
entries.dialogueText: "That was my first thought as well. I don't believe Duchess Azaro would commit such an act."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am unsure what to think. Honestl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am unsure what to think. Honestly, this investigation has muddied more waters than it has cleared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento frowned."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento frowned.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The report they sent seems to heav..."
entries.dialogueText: "The report they sent seems to heavily indicate Duchess Azaro's involvement in what happened."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The investigators secured a testim..."
entries.dialogueText: "The investigators secured a testimony from the commanding officer at the Fort Ales garrison. Apparently he told his men to fire on the Palesians on Duchess Azaro's orders."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He was then coerced into altering..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was then coerced into altering the reports of the incident to suggest that was Pales who shot first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lucita would have to be an idiot t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita would have to be an idiot to think that she could get away with that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And we trust this officer? What if..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we trust this officer? What if he's the one who organized everything?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I always did suspect Duchess Azaro..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always did suspect Duchess Azaro of being disingenuous in her pacifism."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How could she do this while my dau..."
entries.dialogueText: "How could she do this while my daughter was still in Pales? She must have known there was a risk Vina would get caught up in it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It does seem rather obvious for a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It does seem rather obvious for a military officer of her caliber."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The man's record is spotless. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man's record is spotless. But we cannot rule out that possibility."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If she was suspicious of the Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she was suspicious of the Palesians, it was for a reason."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes. She is not her father's daugh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. She is not her father's daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why would she plan such a thing? S..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why would she plan such a thing? She always cautioned me to be diplomatic with the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo sighed heavily."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo sighed heavily.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""To me, these results don't add up...."
entries.dialogueText: "To me, these results don't add up. It is far more likely that Pales -- or someone else -- is trying to paint Rizia as an aggressor to sabotage our gas deal.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I agree that this is far from a cl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree that this is far from a clear-cut case. Lespia had officials on the investigation committee, after all."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""May I remind you of her suggestion..."
entries.dialogueText: "May I remind you of her suggestion to send a naval blockade to Aureus? Had we agreed to that, we would be in far more trouble than we are right now."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""She may have been counting on Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "She may have been counting on Rizia to invade Pales first and ask questions later."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Which gives more credence to the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which gives more credence to the theory that the Duchess is innocent."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Or acting under extreme pressure f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or acting under extreme pressure from her own family."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But we still have a chance to salv..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we still have a chance to salvage our gas deal and our diplomatic relationship with Pales. We just have to ensure the blame for the border attack falls fully on Duchess Azaro's shoulders, not ours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you suggesting we turn in a wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you suggesting we turn in a woman who may be innocent just to avoid conflict?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's obvious to me that Lespia pla..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's obvious to me that Lespia played a role. Most likely hoping that Pales would use the investigation results as grounds to cancel our gas deal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Pales wants us to take our best mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales wants us to take our best military strategist off the chessboard. Rather suspicious, that."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But if that's true, then denying D..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if that's true, then denying Duchess Azaro's involvement is playing right into Lespia's hands."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I don't see another way out of it,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see another way out of it, unfortunately."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Arrest Duchess Azaro now, and we c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest Duchess Azaro now, and we can claim the incident was the work of a sole actor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reinhart demanded reparations, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reinhart demanded reparations, and I paid them. Now he wants our best military strategist?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It could well be the case that Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "It could well be the case that Pales and Lespia were in cahoots all along. They may never have truly intended to sell us the gas field."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Only if Pales is serious about hon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only if Pales is serious about honoring the terms of our deal. Which it may not be."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Pales promised to honor the deal i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales promised to honor the deal if Rizia's name was cleared. If we name Duchess Azaro as the sole actor responsible for the incident, Duke Reinhart will have to go through with the sale."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Defend her, on the other hand, and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Defend her, on the other hand, and Pales as well as the entire international community will believe the Rizian government was behind the border operation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's great news. The Azaro trait..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's great news. The Azaro traitor will face justice, and our deal can proceed as planned."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If she is innocent -- or even if s..."
entries.dialogueText: "If she is innocent -- or even if she is not -- the fallout from House Azaro will be disastrous."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not as disastrous as that from the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not as disastrous as that from the international community should we fail to acknowledge the results of the investigation."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An aide rushed into the chambers wi..."
entries.dialogueText: An aide rushed into the chambers with the blue telephone. Duke Reinhart was calling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and Laurento stayed silent in..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and Laurento stayed silent in the background as I picked up the receiver.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""King Romus. I'm assuming you recei..."
entries.dialogueText: "King Romus. I'm assuming you received the same report that I did?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I received it. I'm still deciding..."
entries.dialogueText: "I received it. I'm still deciding what to make of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. I can't believe my own war co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I can't believe my own war councilor would betray me like that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell me, Your Grace. Did Pales or..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, Your Grace. Did Pales or Lespia have a hand in these investigation results?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm hoping I didn't. Because this..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm hoping I didn't. Because this one is blaming an innocent woman for what happened."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Were you really so surprised, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were you really so surprised, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""What is there to decide, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is there to decide, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Are you trying to deflect the blam..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you trying to deflect the blame, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The volume of his voice rose."
entries.dialogueText: The volume of his voice rose.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Your war councilor's father got us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your war councilor's father got us into this entanglement to begin with. With this gas deal, you were about to acknowledge my country's sovereignty and take the possibility of a second invasion completely off the table. Obviously she wouldn't stand for that."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Innocent? Are you serious?""
entries.dialogueText: "Innocent? Are you serious?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Think about it for a second. Isn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it for a second. Isn't it more likely that Lespia was behind the incident?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Lespia didn't kill my soldiers. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia didn't kill my soldiers. That was all Rizia's doing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our fathers do not determine our d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our fathers do not determine our destiny."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Are you suggesting we accuse an AT..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you suggesting we accuse an ATO member state of falsifying investigation results?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever she did, she acted alone...."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever she did, she acted alone. Neither I nor my other councilors had any knowledge of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Admit it. You don't *want* Rizia t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Admit it. You don't *want* Rizia to acknowledge Palesian sovereignty. It's far more convenient for you to play the victim."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Please, Your Majesty. Make this ea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Majesty. Make this easy for us both."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Arrest the Azaro woman, and we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arrest the Azaro woman, and we can get on with this deal and our lives."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""That's very dangerous ground you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very dangerous ground you're treading."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""In this case, they do. The evidenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this case, they do. The evidence is right in front of our faces."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I believe you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I believe you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still have my suspicions about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still have my suspicions about the legitimacy of these findings. But for the sake of lasting peace between our nations, Duchess Azaro will face justice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rest assured that my war councilor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured that my war councilor will be punished for her treasonous act. I will personally make sure she is shown no mercy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry, Your Grace, but I canno..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Your Grace, but I cannot acknowledge the investigation results. I fully believe that my councilor is innocent."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Your Grand Duchy has double-cr..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Your Grand Duchy has double-crossed me for the last time. I don't know what scheme you're trying to pull, but I won't go along with it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a long silence on the oth..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a long silence on the other end. Laurento and Hugo sat by with bated breath as I awaited the Duke's response.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I am sorry you see it that way, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry you see it that way, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You have left me with no choice. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have left me with no choice. The Aureus deal is off."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento shook his head anxiously."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento shook his head anxiously.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The gas pipeline from the field to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The gas pipeline from the field to Rizia will be dismantled at once. All Rizian vessels in the vicinity will be ordered to leave, and Rizian access to the field will be blocked indefinitely."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This was your plan all along, wasn..."
entries.dialogueText: "This was your plan all along, wasn't it? Take our money, then steal back your gas field."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who will buy the exploration right..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who will buy the exploration rights from you, then? Lespia?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a long silence on the oth..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a long silence on the other end. Laurento and Hugo sat by with bated breath as I awaited the Duke's response.

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Very good, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I'm glad we were able to resolve t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad we were able to resolve this little hiccup in a civil manner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Arresting the heir to one of Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Arresting the heir to one of Rizia's most important noble families is far from a 'little hiccup', Duke Reinhart. I hope you appreciate that."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So am I. I am certain this unpleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "So am I. I am certain this unpleasant affair won't even make it into the history books."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, Your Grace. Surely we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Your Grace. Surely we can still reach some sort of compromise?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart

entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Needless to say, Princess Vina sha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Needless to say, Princess Vina shall be returned home at once. Although I confess I've grown rather fond of having her around."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""The fact that you could even think..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fact that you could even think that is proof your kingdom never wanted to reconcile with Pales in the first place."

entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento, Hugo and I looked at each..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento, Hugo and I looked at each other. Nobody spoke for a moment.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well. As the Rizia Imperii police..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. As the Rizia Imperii police are under Ms. Azaro's command, I'll order the Golden Guard to detain the Duchess until a proper arrest can be made."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell them to tell her I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell them to tell her I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tell them to use as much force as..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I control the Golden Guard. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "I control the Golden Guard. I will give the orders."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes... Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... Of course."
